topic: Weighted Blended OIT (WBOIT) commutative depth-weighted transparency vs unsorted OVER inversion rig
topic_zh: 加权混合顺序无关半透明（WBOIT）可交换深度加权累加对比未排序 OVER 前后倒置
scope: Deterministic McGuire & Bavoil (2013) Weighted Blended Order-Independent Transparency (WBOIT) commutative depth-weighted accumulation versus unsorted Porter-Duff OVER blending and per-pixel A-Buffer sorting across 17 layer depth separations. No neural layer decomposition execution.

protocol.function: C_WBOIT = (1 − Π(1−α_k)) · (Σ α_k C_k w(z_k)) / (Σ α_k w(z_k)) → Order Flip ΔC ≡ 0.0000

robustness.name: Sampled 17 depth separations maintain bit-exact commutative order independence between (Near,Far) and (Far,Near)

good_fit: Overlapping translucent CAD cutaways, automotive glass assemblies, particle smoke plumes, and instanced foliage/hair where per-triangle sorting is impossible
Explaining why decomposing OVER into additive weighted color Σ(αCw(z)) and multiplicative revealage Π(1-α) achieves strict commutativity
Using fixed hardware blend states (GL_ONE, GL_ONE and GL_ZERO, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR) in a single geometry pass without atomic linked lists
Eliminating sudden front-to-back color popping when camera rotation flips bounding-box sort order
not_for: Near-opaque overlapping decals (alpha > 0.95) with conflicting colors where exact per-pixel K-Buffer / Depth Peeling ordering is required
Single non-overlapping transparent layers where standard sorted premultiplied OVER is already exact
Neural multi-layer alpha matting and image decomposition networks
Fully opaque geometry passes using hardware Z-buffer depth writes
